Products

Two units. One standard.

Every record in a sold list is verified within 90 days, stamped with an as-of date, and traceable to its public source.

Unit 1

Venue Lead Lists

One row per venue, by city, region, or venue type. A dated snapshot — not a live feed.

  • Business name, city, state, venue type
  • Verified business email
  • Nocturnal fit score (0–100, from verified signals only)
  • Last-verified date and source, per record
  • No phone numbers in v1. No addresses until verified. No suppressed contacts, ever.
Unit 2

Aggregated Demand Reports

Market signal with no per-venue rows and no contact data at all.

  • Short-staffed cities and hard-to-fill roles
  • Territory coverage — cities touched vs. untouched
  • Trend lines: registrations, touches, replies over time
  • First unit that can ship — it contains no contact data

Why You Need Us

Nobody else sells a verified nightlife-venue list.

Scraped lists go stale the moment they ship. Ours is built the other way round — one verified record at a time, checked by a human, and re-checked every 90 days. That refresh loop is the product: when you buy a list, you buy records that are still true.

Verified beats scraped

Every record carries its proof — tier, source, and last-verified date. If a field can’t be verified, it stays empty.

Bad record? Replaced or credited

A record that bounces, is closed, or is wrong is replaced or credited when reported within 30 days of delivery.

Built for the middle person

You sell to venues. We put the verified record in your hands — so you reach the right room, with the right contact, the first time.

How it works

Built like a record, not a rumor.

1. Public sources only

Official venue sites, public listings, official social profiles. If a field can’t be verified, it stays empty.

2. Tiered verification

Every record carries a tier — Verified Owner, Verified Contact, or Candidate — assigned by rule from the evidence, never by feel.

3. 90-day re-verification

A record past 90 days is stale and re-verified before it ships. Past 180 days, it never ships without re-verification.

4. Provenance per record

Each record states its source and verification date. A buyer can see how every contact was sourced.

5. Suppression honored

Bounced and opted-out addresses are stripped from every extract, permanently — and buyers must honor the suppression list shipped with their data.

6. Pay before access

No free access to records. Prospects see counts and tiers only; paying buyers receive a dated snapshot with the buyer terms attached.

The Verified Standard

How A Record Earns Verified Owner

Five checks. Every one must pass before a record carries the Verified Owner tier.

1

It Exists And It Trades

Licence active in the public record (FL ABT 4COP or the equivalent ABC record) or a live, current public presence — website or social posting in the last 90 days — with a matching address. Closed venues are removed, not sold.

2

The Contact Is Published Or Filed

The email comes from the venue’s own website or social pages, or the contact is named in a public filing. Never a guessed pattern presented as verified. Never a bought row resold as-is.

3

Two Independent Email Checks

The email passes two independent verification checks (Hunter Verifier + Bouncer or ZeroBounce). One check is not enough. A catch-all result is never verified.

4

The Decision-Maker Is Named Where Findable

Owner or GM name and role, from a filing, the venue’s own site, or a public profile. Where no decision-maker can be found, the record is tiered down honestly.

5

A Human Signed Off

A person checked the row, dated it, and noted the sources. No record ships on machine output alone.

Re-verified every 90 days. Every record is re-verified at least every 90 days. A record that fails re-verification is retired or re-checked before it is sold again — never sold stale.

The Buyer Promise

No Traps. No Fine Print.

Data sellers in this category are famous for billing traps and accuracy claims that collapse on first use. These terms are the opposite — and they are part of the price, not an afterthought.

Bad Record? Replaced Or Credited

A record that bounces, is closed, or is wrong is replaced or credited when reported within 30 days of delivery. Never a guarantee of replies, meetings, or sales.

Reminder Before Every Renewal

No silent auto-renewal. A reminder goes out well before the renewal date, every time.

Cancel In One Click

Self-serve cancellation, effective immediately. No written-notice window, no retention call to cancel.

Price You Sign At Is The Price You Keep

No renewal hikes without notice. If a price ever changes, it changes for new buyers only.

Pay Before Access

Prospects see counts and tiers only — venue names, business emails, addresses, websites, and fit scores are never shown here. A paying buyer receives one dated snapshot extract: active records only, held / suppressed / test records stripped, nothing older than 180 days, with the buyer terms and the suppression list attached.

Suppression Honored

Bounced and opted-out addresses are stripped from every extract, permanently — and buyers must honor the suppression list shipped with their data.
